paragraphs.text: Jeff Grubb is an American author and game designer. He wrote several highly acclaimed novels for Magic: The Gathering .

Grubb worked on the Dungeons & Dragons Dragonlance campaign setting under Tracy Hickman , and the Forgotten Realms setting with Ed Greenwood . His written works include The Finder's Stone Trilogy, the Spelljammer and Jakandor campaign settings, and contributions to Dragonlance and the computer game Guild Wars Nightfall (2006).
